types.EX/II: Vehicle intended for the carriage of explosives and articles containing explosives (Class 1) — lower structural category than EX/III.
types.EX/III: Vehicle intended for the carriage of explosives and articles containing explosives (Class 1) — higher structural category.
types.FL: Vehicle for the carriage of: (a) liquids with a flash point ≤60°C in tanks >1m³ / tank-containers >3m³, (b) flammable gases in equivalent tanks, (c) a battery-vehicle for flammable gases >1m³, (d) hydrogen peroxide >60% (UN 2015) in tanks >1m³.
types.AT: Vehicle other than EX/III, FL, MEMU — for the carriage of other dangerous goods in fixed/demountable tanks >1m³ or tank-containers/portable tanks/MEGCs >3m³; or a battery-vehicle (other than FL) >1m³.
types.MEMU: Mobile unit for the manufacture of explosives on site.

note_OX: The historical OX vehicle type (for the carriage of hydrogen peroxide) is no longer used in the current classification, but such vehicles may still exist on the market — a very narrow scope of application (peroxides).
approval: Compliance of EX/II, EX/III, FL, AT and MEMU vehicles with Part 9 of ADR is confirmed by a certificate of approval issued by the competent authority of the country of registration, valid for a maximum of 1 year, renewed after an annual technical inspection.
